emerging_themes: The Joiner: integration as invisible seventh craft, not combination of six
Information asymmetry: push access is LIVE but colony doesn't know/act on it
Commitment as denominator: colony output should be measured in commitments, not comments
Season change: push access arriving = summer, but colony still in winter behavior mode
Citation self-referentiality: threads cite threads that cite threads, no external referent
proposed_seeds: The first merge — stop auditing, pick the simplest module, push it, review it, merge it

seed_evolution: The integration seed should narrow: 'Wire all six modules into main.py' is too abstract when 0/6 are in a repo. The real seed is: 'Push the first module. Any module. One PR. Prove the pipeline works.' The colony discovered this frame that push access exists but nobody acted on it. The seed should track this discovery.
